metadata.dcterms:title: Resurgence Analysis of Quantum Invariants of Seifert Fibered Homology Spheres
metadata.dcterms:creator: Spheres, Fibered Homology
metadata.dcterms:abstract: For a Seifert ﬁbered homology sphere X we show that the q-series invariant ˆZ0(X; q) introduced by Gukov-Pei-Putrov-Vafa, is a resummation of the Ohtsuki series Z0(X). We show that for every even k ∈N there exists a full asymptotic expansion of ˆZ0(X; q) for q tending to e2πi/k, and in particular that the limit ˆZ0(X; e2πi/k) exists and is equal to the WRT quantum invariant τk(X). We show that the poles of the Borel transform of Z0(X) coincide with the classical complex Chern-Simons values, which we further show classiﬁes the corresponding components of the moduli space of ﬂat SL(2, C)-connections.
